claim_comment: Closing the memory conformance crate only after one provider-neutral harness runs mandatory descriptor, capability, handshake, health, observation, and recall checks against a dummy provider; fixtures pin exact contract, provider, implementation, and build identities; scenario and differential outputs retain only canonical terminal metadata and digests; and observer results cannot contain or replace product output.

checks.name: canonical provider Rust bindings remain generated
working tree has no whitespace damage

acceptance_criteria: The mandatory provider-neutral suite runs descriptor identity, required capabilities, handshake, health, observation acceptance, and recall against a dummy MemoryProvider and passes.

Every fixture carries a versioned contract identity, exact contract-set SHA-256, stable provider ID, exact provider build ID, and immutable implementation SHA-256, and rejects target or mandatory-operation mismatches.
Scenario and differential reports compare only provider-visible operations, typed terminals, exact-scope identities, and canonical payload digests rather than provider-internal state.

ObserverConformanceResult can retain only an opaque ProductOutputDigest plus an isolated conformance report; it contains no product-output bytes, prompt mutation surface, or active-provider replacement path.
close_reason: Added the isolated provider-neutral memory conformance crate with exact identity fixtures, mandatory dummy-provider coverage, reusable scenario execution, differential terminal reports, and structurally isolated observer results.
close_comment: Evidence: crates/tracedecay-memory-conformance depends only on tracedecay-memory-provider-api and is usable without the dashboard, host, fabric, Native adapter, NCM adapter, stores, or code index. FixtureIdentity pins the versioned canonical contract, contract-set digest, provider ID, provider build, and immutable implementation digest. MandatoryConformanceFixture enforces exact provider targets and fixed health/observe/recall slots. ConformanceHarness deterministically checks descriptor identity, mandatory capabilities, read-only handshake, health, observation acceptance, recall, terminal operation identity, and exact-scope digest. ProviderScenario and ScenarioRunner retain comparable typed terminal metadata and payload digests without provider state. DifferentialReport compares index-aligned external outcomes. ProductOutputDigest and ObserverConformanceResult make observer evidence incapable of carrying product-output bytes or replacing active output. The dummy-provider integration journeys pass mandatory conformance, expose a differential recall failure, and prove observer digest/report isolation. Validation branch run 33335324279 passed formatting, strict all-target Clippy, and focused tests before promotion; the serialized closure reruns those gates with the full M2 crate set and patch-policy checks.
